Many nations have risen and fallen since the [[Breaking of the World]]. Some are remembered now only in name and in song - others do not even have that.

The subcategories for the historical nations are split into three main time periods.

# '''AFTER BREAKING''' - concerning the [[Ten Nations]] that came to existence after the Breaking and which formed the Compact of Ten Nations until the time of the [[Trolloc Wars]].<br>
#'''THE FREE YEARS'''- concerning the many nations that arose from the destruction of the Trolloc Wars until the time of [[Guaire Amalasan]] and the subsequent unification of the lands during the [[Consolidation]] under [[Artur Hawkwing]] and the eventual formation of his Empire.<br>
#'''FORMER NATIONS OF THE NEW ERA'''- concerning those nations that arose from the breakup of Hawkwing's Empire, but which have not survived to the present day.
